regions.cleaned_text: I surely thank you for your practical way of remember- ing me on my 76th birthday. I hope the dear Lord may be pleased to leave yourself with us till you round out the 100. After all that cant be much more than a dozen years. So take courage and stay till your ripe enough for Heaven to take a "no stop-passage." . God's blessing and graces to yourself and to all our dear friends in Detroit.
